svg.aria-label: Us overview: scattered U letters are matched into groups, share emotions, get support from the UsBot AI companion, then get pulled together by a magnet-shaped U to form the Us logo.
svg.text: FindUs matches you with groups, SeeU lets you share how
you feel, and HelpU offers a local AI companion.
Built solo and backed by an academic paper.

g.text: Us is many U, U belong to Us
